text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...A local community revival event, you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The academy has agreed to 
cooperate. We are planning a race event 
set in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Horse girls sprinting freely throughout 
the shopping street, treating it as a 
course. With various checkpoints prepared 
along the way—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat! That's awesome, that's awesome! 
Sounds super-duper fun!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... careful, careful. Can't let them 
spot me... *staaaare*.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And here is the event proposal... ...It 
certainly looks like an all-out effort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The people of the shopping district 
look after our academy's students 
regularly. An opportunity such as this is 
precisely when we must repay that 
kindness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To that end, we sought to prepare a highly 
entertaining event that everyone could 
enjoy...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...However, as you well know, my innate 
nature tends toward being far too rigid.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There still appears to be room for 
reconsideration regarding whether the 
populace will truly be able to enjoy this 
plan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Just hearing about it sounds super 
fun to me, though...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, in any case... Nishishi! ...All 
right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan! Golshi! Got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Something really fun is happening in the 
shopping district soon! And listen, 
listen—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez, listen! It's about the "Shopping 
District Race"!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...! Teio, how did you come to know of 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Now, now~! Nothing escapes my keen eyes♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So get this! I came up with some extra 
additions! It's kind of piggybacking off 
your original idea, Prez, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Together with us and you, Prez, let's get 
everyone super-duper thrilled!!

On my day off, I visited the shopping 
district and found a massive crowd 
gathered there.
choice_data_list:
(...? What on earth is all this excitement 
about—)

text_block_list.name: Commentator (Teio)
text_block_list.text:
The Shopping District Race is reaching its 
climax! Coming up ahead of our leader, 
Symboli Rudolf, is... Huh? Ooooh~?! What 
in the world is that~~?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Madam President! Next up is 
a banana speed-eating showdown with me!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What... Special Week holds the ramen 
eating contest record, you know?! Even for 
Symboli Rudolf, taking her on is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Though it be like a mantis trying to 
stop a chariot, I accept the challenge. 
Special Week, victory shall be mine.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhhhhh?! She's actually doing it?! Go 
get 'em, Symboli Rudolf—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Slipping a speed-eating battle against 
Spe-chan right into the middle! When 
people think of horse girls, watching them 
chow down with gusto is super popular, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Along with appetite, there's jumping power 
and raw strength too! If we show off horse 
girl power in all sorts of crazy ways, 
everyone's guaranteed to love it!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa there, full stop right here!! 
You've entered the World Pole Vaulting 
Championship arena, pal.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My dried sardine is currently attempting a 
massive 7-meter world record! Think you've 
got what it takes to clear that, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator (Teio)
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa, what a bizarre challenge out of 
nowhere! What are you gonna do, Prez?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—In short, I merely need to clear seven 
meters, correct?

text_block_list.name: Commentator (Teio)
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Prez is just way too cool~♡ And 
now, and now?! Taking the pole in hand, 
facing down the 7-meter wall—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: She cleared ittttttt?!

The shopping district race continues 
amidst thunderous cheers. Moved by both 
the chaotic obstacles and the lively live 
commentary, the crowd's hearts are 
completely captivated—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That race was amazing all the way through, 
wasn't it? The big eating contest was 
wild, and then that soaring jump...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Right?! When I heard the student council 
was running it, I thought it'd be super 
stiff and formal... Turns out that student 
council president actually has a great 
sense of humor!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Great work out there, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...! Teio, I am truly grateful for your 
help. Thanks to you, it was an 
earth-shattering success—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hold on, hold on, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's because of me, everyone... and you, 
Prez! That's why this event was such a 
huge blast!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It was your original idea to begin with. 
And you were open-minded enough to 
flexibly accept all my crazy additions—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's super glad! If you were 
just a stiff, serious horse girl, Prez, 
we'd never have been able to do something 
this fun together!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

Symboli Rudolf gently places her hand upon 
Tokai Teio's head. Bathed in the evening 
glow, the two share a tender smile.
